ValidationRule.description: CC-3472: Lead record must be editable only when lead status in New/InProgress/Opportunity Identified.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false,NOT(CONTAINS( $User.Username,$Label.UnicaIntegrationUserName)), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MLCRM_Lead', NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), NOT(ISCHANGED(Skip_Validations__c)), NOT(Skip_Validations__c = 'ConvertLead'), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "No Opportunity"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Converted"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Referred"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Expired") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Lead cannot be updated at this stage.
